card.name: Small words in political history
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, for, the, an, his, in) in history and politics passages about leaders, movements, governments and rebellions, just before a title, group or role is named.

modes.label: Before an office or title
modes.description: A linking word right before a political position or former title.
modes.example: but was offered only the position<< of>> vice-chancellor in a coalition government —

modes.label: Inside movement or group names
modes.description: A linking word inside the name of a political or rights group.
modes.example: Alabama Christian Movement<< for>> Civil Rights Lee Martin, "The

modes.label: Before political goals or actions
modes.description: A word in a sentence about revolt, protest or forming a government.
modes.example: with a view to the formation<< of>> a Southern Confederacy.

card.writes: It pushes down words for factions, gangs and partitions, and slightly raises certification-style words; the net effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in history texts about politics, revolutions and rights movements.
